productReadContract: 五板块/精确 session/关系/公开结果的读取只由 App 纯组合既有 owner 事实，再进入 human-readable-ux-reading；本图只保留 task-level 观测 truth，不作为产品关系链，也不新增第二事实源。

http_api.ownerSymbol: UiRuntime server semantic GET/SSE and observation GET routes
http_api.contract: The observation route parses optionalI2ReadScope, the scope subtree, node selection and decodeTaskAgentActivitySelectionQuery, then calls UiRuntimeService.scopedObservation.

load_task_truth.contract: The shared resolver selects the serve-bound live source or the declared project/mode durable inventory. Foreign admissions come from that inventory, not the serve-bound requirementAdmissions map. The same selected task scope supplies already owner-decoded native allocation, active-turn, resumed-segment, child invocation and delivery, review, and Planner records. Those typed facts are the actual-execution source; assignment-graph fact replay is not required. For a valid bound live read, App overlays only a captured pending Runtime publication state onto the authoritative same-binding durable projection; successful durable commits, output text and publicCommitWatermark remain the durable values, and no uncommitted text is exposed. A read failure retains the current confirmed commits and watermark as unknown. Foreign durable reads remain durable reads and do not borrow serve-bound live publication. Both semantic builders forward the defined snapshot publicOutput (state and commits with exact {ref, text}) and its publicCommitWatermark into the semantic envelope unchanged; order, text, refs and the two independent watermarks are preserved, and an absent value stays omitted without a new reader. Missing or unavailable sources remain explicit. The committed taskFlow binding resolves the static read-only TaskFlowGuidance in packages/core/src/task-flow-definition.ts; its typed stages, dependencies, layout and loops ride the same task_projection payload. For product board/session read, A1 composes this same task truth with exact refs and scope; load_task_truth does not mint a session identity or a board classification.

project_semantic_views.ownerSymbol: selectTaskAgentActivity and the Runtime pure actual-execution selector boundary
project_semantic_views.contract: The Runtime pure selector classifies the same selected task scope's typed native records without stores, logs, Manager creation, acquire, rebind, or writes. Existing RuntimeAgentActivityProjection.actualExecutionGraph then carries the contracts source through packages/ui/projection/actual-execution-graph.ts. Guidance, current plan, and recorded instances stay distinct; exact missing relations remain ungrouped or unavailable. The guidance projection is owned by packages/ui/projection/actual-execution-graph.ts; the template skeleton stays distinct from the current plan and recorded instances and adds no graph node or edge.

project_status_and_actions.contract: UiRuntimeService builds node facts before this projection. task.output is projected only from authoritative committed public publication; missing publication is explicit and raw execution evidence is not presented as final output.

browser_view.ownerSymbol: mountPageTemplate explicit-root slots + mountSemanticObservationPanel + readSerial/streamRevision guards, closeStream/dispose lifecycle, createRuntimeReadPublication freeze/snapshot publication, createDisplayPreferenceController subscribe/dispose, mountSemanticObservation view callbacks, and openTechnicalDetail shared detail/focus carrier; task-dashboard.js/observation.js pagehide ownership
browser_view.sharedTemplateContract: mountPageTemplate(root, config) owns one explicit root and the heading/status/primary/support/composer slots for collection, work, and standalone layouts. Optional support and composer slots stay visually absent until real content exists. openTechnicalDetail is the single product detail/focus carrier: opening a detail replaces any open detail and closes the four-corner shell layer, opening a four-corner section closes the detail, and closing returns focus to the explicit trigger. mountSemanticObservation no longer owns a dialog; it renders reusable evidence content and emits onEvidenceRequest(evidence, trigger) only. mountSemanticObservationPanel defaults that callback to openTechnicalDetail and preserves its existing GET/SSE read serial, revision, stale, and scope-ref semantics. Page controllers stop timers/streams, dispose feature mounts, then dispose the shared template; standalone skips business navigation, the four-corner shell, and display-preference subscriptions.
browser_view.contract: The UI-owned public helper api.observation in docs/ui/runtime-api.js is the observation read boundary; its fifth taskScope argument accepts one complete typed task scope or a legacy null/undefined absence. The private read-scope appender appendI2TaskScope is the single read-edge position that maps legacy null/undefined absence to omitted, so the request writes no projectKey or mode and keeps the existing serve-bound read; a complete scope is forwarded unchanged, and a partial or invalid pair stays rejected before the request. It never guesses a projectKey, adds no required-read-scope registry or fallback dual chain, and leaves taskControlScopeQuery as the unchanged strict formal control scope validator used by the formal control request builders. The existing scope query remains the observation subtree and node remains the selected node; the agent query keeps the existing decoder. Both formal pages consume the same agentActivity read and actualExecutionGraph carrier without a second fetch. Presentation keeps guidance, current plan, and actual-recorded instances separate; technical IDs and commit refs stay in detail, while unavailable and ungrouped records remain visible. The shared browser projection preserves each published coverage issue's readable reason; its scope, sourceRef, and optional eventRef remain checkable in the existing read-only evidence details, and the gap never rebuilds pairing or control state. A coverage section defaults to a collapsed native disclosure: its summary keeps the readable description and full count, expanding preserves every published issue in the published order and keeps the existing read-only evidence entry for exact refs, and collapsing changes neither pairing nor control state. The shared browser projection also renders committed publicOutput.commits as confirmed stable text under the existing selected scope, shows typed pending as a status-only live item, and keeps prior confirmed commits with an unknown/unavailable notice; it never fabricates commit evidence or timestamps. Browser modules are owner-local: runtime-api.js freezes and publishes one content reference per scope/revision; runtime-shell.js mounts the explicit-root shared template, subscribes to display preferences, retains the semantic panel across renders, guards GET/SSE with read serial and stream revision, marks disconnects stale, disposes the stream, and routes evidence through the single openTechnicalDetail detail/focus carrier; semantic-observation.js renders reusable evidence content and emits view/evidence callbacks only; task-dashboard.js and observation.js dispose controller reads/streams, feature mounts, then the shared template on pagehide. Task Dashboard and Pipeline Observation are the delivered preference surfaces. Other shell pages deliberately omit it. This does not establish a global event bus or a native cross-process Arc. renderTaskActualExecutionGraphSection in docs/ui/task-display.js renders the template skeleton under data-task-flow-guidance="skeleton" with data-template-stage, data-template-dependency and data-template-loop, distinct from data-plan-node and data-actual-execution-node, using shared card and relation helpers. Product board/session view uses exact ProductTargetRef and read scope; opening, closing, Back/Forward and refresh only re-read, never submit a decision or restart a task.
